visual_references.observation: Red highlighted irregular sector block on whole-city reference; compare canal, streets and plaza.
Red highlighted southern strip; distinguish district sector extent from rooftop routes.
Green highlighted zone visible on both banks of Saison Canal; corroborates textual cross-district extent.

discrepancies.finding: Jaune 10 and Vert 6 on opposite canal banks; text and highlighted picture agree. Do not imply straight walk across water.
Bleu 1, Bleu 2 and Bleu Street overlap. Keep sector and Wild Zone as independent layers.
Electrical Substation near Magenta 6; Wild Zone 14 page infobox contradicts its geography text. Check in-game header.
Bulbapedia lists Talonflame Lv45–46 where other reviewed tables omit it. Fixed Alpha Pyroar form listings also differ; retain existing roster until verified.
Prior AT-322 Gastly listing discrepancy remains unresolved; compare ordinary spawns with PokéMaps and in-game record.
Mission 30/31 wording differs; observe exact gate state before/after progression.
Preserve existing ordinary 15 and possible rotating Alpha 67; two rotating slots are not 67 simultaneous spawns. External map coordinates cannot be pasted into Atlas.
Meowstic male night, female day, source-reported; verify without assuming flattened table weather columns.
Source-reported flower colours: WZ3 Flabébé red/blue/white; WZ7 Floette red/orange; WZ16 Florges blue/white. Preserve species and form separately.
Serebii area data includes Trevenant, Noibat and Banette where some other tables differ. Retain existing entries and separate roof and street encounters.

Mission encounters are not automatically wild catches: WZ6 side180 Alpha Annihilape and WZ17 side114 Skarmory are reported noncatchable; WZ3 Steelix, WZ5 Gallade, WZ9 Pangoro and WZ11 Xerneas need mission-specific records.
